visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man wearing a tan cap, safety glasses, an orange jumpsuit, and an orange and white scarf is looking down at a black shopping bag. He is in a workshop setting with a gray pegboard wall behind him filled with various power tools like drills and grinders. (2) A close-up shot transitions to show a black cylindrical tea tin labeled with Chinese characters. The camera pans to show the top of the lid and the side label detailing the product information. (3) The man in the orange jumpsuit looks toward the camera and gestures with his hands while holding the tea tin. He appears to be explaining something in a conversational manner. (4) The scene shifts to show a second man in a denim jacket and blue cap standing next to the first man. They are both in the workshop, interacting and laughing together. (5) A close-up of the man in orange jumpsuit continues as he speaks directly, holding the tin. Pink petal-like graphics float across the frame as he gestures. (6) The video ends with a promotional graphic screen featuring a thumbnail of the two men, social media icons, and informative text overlays over the tool wall background.
